scope: GUC-gated situational recall: recall_situation() now honours pgmnemo.include_unverified with the same EXCEPTION-safe pattern as recall_hybrid(), recall_fast(), and recall_lessons(). Function converted from LANGUAGE sql to LANGUAGE plpgsql (required for block-level EXCEPTION handler). Default behaviour change: when the GUC is unset (the default), only rows with verified_at IS NOT NULL are returned — callers relying on the 0.15.0 all-rows default must SET pgmnemo.include_unverified = 'on'. No schema change, no new index, no ranking or scoring change.
justification: Functional gate — recall_situation() is a pure lookup function; the change gates on a GUC, not on any ranking or scoring coefficient. The GUC-read pattern (EXCEPTION-safe current_setting + COALESCE) is identical to the implementation already shipped in recall_hybrid(), recall_fast(), recall_lessons(), and traverse_temporal_window(). No statistical validation is required because no recall-quality metric is claimed. Both installcheck suites green (extension suite: 53/53, root suite: 9/9) including the test_v0151_guc_situation suite which covers the new GUC filtering path end-to-end.
schema_change_detail: No table, column, index, or GUC definition change. recall_situation() body replaced in-place (LANGUAGE sql → LANGUAGE plpgsql, GUC filtering added). COMMENT ON FUNCTION updated to describe actual behaviour. Upgrade path: pgmnemo--0.15.0--0.15.1.sql. Fresh-install path: pgmnemo--0.15.1.sql.
scoring_impact: none — recall ranking, confidence, and reinforce() paths are untouched; no changes to recall_hybrid(), recall_fast(), or any scoring coefficient
recall_ranking_impact: none — no change to result ordering, RRF weights, graph-proximity boost, recency stamping, or any GUC
backward_compat_proof: Callers of recall_situation() with pgmnemo.include_unverified = 'on' (all installcheck fixtures and the standard production pattern) see no change. Callers that relied on the 0.15.0 all-rows default and have unverified rows in their corpus will silently receive fewer results; they must set the GUC or verify their rows. All 52 pre-existing extension/ tests continue to pass. test_v0151_guc_situation verifies GUC filtering end-to-end.

corpus.note: functional gate only; no recall-quality claim is made by this release and therefore no statistical validation is required
